notes.title: The black & white theme glitch fix
notes.notes:
If you played in the black & white theme, you probably encountered some graphical glitches. This update fixes those issues.

Probably the most noticeable occurrence was on the final party scene. If you already finished the game in black & white, it could've made little sense. In that case, you should be able to replay the scene by selecting the 'continue' option in the main menu (if you didn't start a new playthrough already).

notes.title: Demo update!

So that being said, after your feedback we added an option to choose a different theme to personalize your experience and/or give your eyes a rest. Blue? Pink? Sepia? It’s your decision!
